title: An isomorphism of the free group factors
summary: We solve the free group factor isomorphism problem affirmatively by proving that $`L(\mathbb F_2)`$ and $`L(\mathbb F_3)`$ are isomorphic as tracial von Neumann algebras. The classical free group factor alternative then implies that all interpolated free group factors, including $`L(\mathbb F_\infty)`$, are isomorphic and have fundamental group $`\mathbb R_{\gt 0}`$.
